entries.description: An inhabitant starts an action.
An inhabitant finishes an action.
An action is cancelled (target gone, no way there).
An inhabitant asks the AI about something it does not understand.
The AI answered a question.
A question could not be answered.
A queued answer was dropped before it started because a need it does not serve fell below its neglect threshold.
A thought of an inhabitant (text in the player's language).
An inhabitant now knows or believes something new, with its source (B4a R3).
An inhabitant now knows another inhabitant's own name (W1698): actor = the learner, target = the one whose name it learned.
Two inhabitants who did not know each other see each other for the first time (B4a R8, F5249): actor = the one with the lower id, target = the other.
A lasting lack becomes the wish to invent something.
The final check refused an invention.
An invention job failed.
An invention was approved.
A building plan was approved.
A building plan was refused.
A building step is done.
Building gave up: after too many plans, or (detail no_material) after waiting too long without material in sight.
A builder found no material for a building step for long and needs help (detail: the material's properties; text in_world when some lies elsewhere).
A builder took a thing of another kind for the missing material, and it truly has what was missing.
A builder tried a thing of another kind for the missing material, but it lacks what was missing; the builder learned that.
An invention was built.
An invention was used for the first time.
The player placed a gift.
An inhabitant really lacks something and calls for help.
A new skill from an invention was not taken into the register (duplicate, limit or invalid).
A new need from an invention was not taken into the register (duplicate, limit or invalid).
An inhabitant used a thing of an invention for the first time and now has the need it brings.
A message arrived in the player's mailbox (Detail = message kind).
An unread message knocks again (Detail = message kind).
An inhabitant sees an old readable text of another author for the first time: writing found again (B8 R15; target = the object, Detail = author).
The player said something to an inhabitant; the inhabitant thinks about it (Text = the player sentence; thought bubble while waiting).
An inhabitant answers the player (Text = the answer in the player language, checked by the content guard; Detail = expression or empty).
An inhabitant answers the player with a gesture only (Detail = expression).
An inhabitant does not want to answer the player (Text = optional short answer).
An inhabitant did not understand the player (B2511: becomes a question to the AI with a question mark).
No answer came (AI service off or too slow, R16): calm hint, favour given back.
An inhabitant is born (B8 R9 chronicle; reported by the core once families exist, B9; target = a parent).
An inhabitant has died, gently after long neglect (B8 R9; reported by the core, B9). Stays in the chronicle.
Two inhabitants quarrelled (B8 R9; target = the other inhabitant; reported by the core once relationships change through conflict).
Two inhabitants made up after a quarrel (B8 R9; target = the other inhabitant).
Two inhabitants became partners (B8 R9; target = the other inhabitant).
An inhabitant moved to live somewhere else (B8 R9; reported by the core once settlements exist).
An inhabitant discovered a new way of working, a process (B4b; action = the process; reported by the core once processes are discovered). The chronicle kind of the same name waited for it.
A storm began (B2-5 R13; Detail = the weather condition; no inhabitant). Named by the signals of the climate data.
A storm is over (B2-5 R13; Detail = the weather condition; no inhabitant).
A drought began: the dry days of the climate are reached or the drought weather set in (B2-5 R13; Detail = the weather condition).
A drought is over (B2-5 R13; Detail = the weather condition).
The player set the weather (B2-5 R13, command set_weather; Detail = the weather).
The look epoch of the world changed (B2-5 R16, commands set_look_epoch and debug_set_look_epoch; Detail = the epoch).
The compute night went through an inhabitant's open questions about things (Detail = 'asked=N,skipped=M'; skipped = nothing to guess from yet, the question waits).
